events.title: Hydroponics Fault
events.body: A nutrient line in the hydroponics bay has dropped pressure. Yields will fall unless the array is rebalanced now.

choices.label: Rebalance the array
choices.description: Divert energy and materials to restore full growth cycles.

choices.label: Run at reduced capacity
choices.description: Conserve supplies and accept smaller harvests.

events.title: Reactor Warning
events.body: Diagnostic sensors flag irregular output in the primary reactor. Engineering requests permission to pull maintenance crews from other shifts.

choices.label: Authorize full inspection
choices.description: Spend medicine to rotate exhausted crews through sick bay.

choices.label: Defer maintenance
choices.description: Keep current output and log the warning.

events.title: Probe Recovery
events.body: A survey probe returns with intact sensor logs from the next transition corridor. Analysts want time to decode the archive.

choices.label: Decode the archive
choices.description: Use energy and materials to extract navigation data.

choices.label: Warehouse the probe
choices.description: Store the hardware for later study.

events.title: Unknown Contact
events.body: Long-range sensors hold a hard return on an intercept vector. The contact mirrors every course change the arkship makes.

choices.label: Raise shields and hold course
choices.description: Prepare the arkship for a hostile encounter.

choices.label: Attempt open broadcast
choices.description: Signal the contact with a peaceful greeting.

events.title: Memorial Service
events.body: The crew gathers to honor those lost in the encounter. Names are read, bells are rung, and the arkship sails on.

choices.label: Hold the service
choices.description: A formal observance restores collective spirit.

choices.label: Private remembrance
choices.description: Crews grieve in their own way without ceremony.
